## Company Overview

**Name:** Webimot Agency
**Also known as:** Webimot, Webimot AI Agency
**Type:** AI automation agency — AI agents and automation systems for clinics and small businesses
**Promise:** "AI automation systems that run your daily work."
**Founder:** Sia Ahmadi — founded Webimot in January 2025 and does the client work personally. Since 2021 worked in sales and marketing for clinics in Istanbul treating international patients (BHT Clinic, Ariana Health Clinic, and since November 2023 Dr. Görkem Atsal Clinic as a freelance sales and marketing specialist); digital marketing for WaveMed (US healthcare startup), 2021–2024. MSc Information Technology (Azad University); completing an MSc in Consultancy and Entrepreneurship at Rotterdam Business School. Works in English, Turkish, Persian and Kurdish, with basic Dutch. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sia-ahmadi/ · Bio: https://webimotagency.com/about#founder
**Based in:** Amsterdam (Netherlands) and Istanbul (Turkey); works with clients remotely
**Email:** webimot.info@gmail.com
**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/webimotagency/
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/webimot-agency/
**WhatsApp:** +31628753175
**Website:** https://webimotagency.com
**WhatsApp AI product site:** https://webimot.com

Webimot Agency builds and operates AI automation systems for clinics and small businesses so that every lead is answered, every document processed and every follow-up sent — 24/7, without adding staff. The offer is one ladder of four systems: Capture (WhatsApp AI, LeadFire), Follow-up (NurtureLoop, ReviveIQ), Operations (DocuMind, AI agents for daily tasks) and Reporting (ClearDesk). Meta Ads, Google Ads and SEO / SEO Blog AI are sold as add-ons that feed the Capture system.

## Who We Help (two audiences)

1. **Clinics & healthcare** — hair transplant, dental, cosmetic surgery and IVF clinics, including medical tourism providers serving patients from Germany, the UK, the Netherlands and the Gulf. Promise: turn every patient enquiry into a booked consultation. https://webimotagency.com/clinics
2. **Small businesses** — real estate agencies, e-commerce and Shopify stores, finance and legal firms and service businesses that live on WhatsApp, email and spreadsheets. Promise: run on AI without hiring more staff. https://webimotagency.com/small-business

## The Four Systems (the ladder)

1. **Capture system — WhatsApp AI · LeadFire** — Every enquiry answered in seconds, in the customer's language, 24/7. An AI agent on your WhatsApp Business number (and web chat) answers questions, qualifies the lead, evaluates photos where relevant and books the appointment straight into your calendar. Replaces: missed messages and slow replies. Designed to reply within about a minute, day and night, in the customer's language. https://webimotagency.com/systems#capture
2. **Follow-up system — NurtureLoop · ReviveIQ** — Leads that went quiet get followed up automatically until they book or opt out. Multi-step follow-up across WhatsApp, email and SMS for new leads, plus reactivation campaigns for old contacts already in your CRM or inbox. Replaces: leads that go cold. Designed so that: no lead is forgotten after the first message; old contacts turned back into bookings; hand-off to your team when a human is needed. https://webimotagency.com/systems#convert
3. **Operations system — DocuMind · AI agents for daily tasks** — Invoices, forms and data entry handled by AI agents instead of your team. Agents read incoming documents, extract the data, update your systems and send the reminders and internal follow-ups your team does by hand today (invoices, intake forms, contracts, HR requests). Replaces: manual paperwork and data entry. Designed so that: documents are processed the day they arrive; human-verified accuracy on what matters; hours per week back to your team. https://webimotagency.com/systems#operate
4. **Reporting system — ClearDesk** — A plain-English report on leads, sales and team performance every Monday. AI pulls the numbers from WhatsApp, CRM, ads, calendar and accounting and sends a short weekly report with what changed, what to fix and what to double down on. Replaces: not knowing what's working. https://webimotagency.com/systems#measure

## Paid ads (sold on their own or with the systems)

- **Meta Ads for clinics** — Facebook and Instagram ads for clinics and medical tourism: audiences by country and language, lead forms and click-to-WhatsApp ads, creatives within Meta's health ad rules, tracking to booked consultations. Sold on its own or with the WhatsApp AI, which answers every ad lead in under 3 seconds. https://webimotagency.com/services/meta-ads
- **Google Ads for clinics** — Google Search ads for clinics and medical tourism: high-intent treatment and price searches per country and language, negative keywords, offline conversion import so bidding learns from booked consultations, checked against Google's healthcare policy. Sold on its own or with the WhatsApp AI. https://webimotagency.com/services/google-ads
- **How ads work** — Ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platform, in the client's own ad account; the management fee is quoted after a free 30-minute strategy call (recommended minimum spend: €500/month on Meta, €1,000/month on Google). Ads have been run by founder Sia Ahmadi for five clinics: Gorkem Atsal Clinic, Clinish, Prime Hair, MSB Aesthetic and Estetizm. No guaranteed cost per lead.

## Add-on

- **SEO & SEO Blog AI** — Organic traffic from automated, search-optimised articles. https://webimotagency.com/products/seo-blog-ai

## Pricing — Three Packages, One Ladder

No fixed prices are published. Every package is quoted after a free AI audit, so clients only pay for the systems they will actually use. Request a quote: https://webimotagency.com/contact

- **Starter — "Capture every lead"** — Capture system. Best for one location, one inbox, first step into AI. Includes: Capture system set up and managed, WhatsApp AI live within 48 hours, weekly summary email, 1 integration (calendar or CRM), onboarding and team training.
- **Growth — "Capture, follow up and measure"** — Capture + Follow-up + Reporting systems. Best for clinics and SMEs ready to automate the whole lead journey. Includes: regular optimisation reviews, priority support, additional integrations.
- **Scale — "Run the business on AI"** — All four systems. Best for multi-location or multi-team businesses. Includes: new automations added over time, strategy sessions, custom integrations and API connections.

## How an Engagement Works

1. Free AI audit — 3 days, no credit card, no commitment; top 5 automation opportunities with ROI estimates
2. Build & deploy — WhatsApp AI live within 48 hours of onboarding; wider builds 2–4 weeks, integrated with existing tools, with go-live support and team training; the client owns the system
3. Manage & scale — monthly retainer: monitoring, optimisation and new automations

**Integrations:** WhatsApp Business, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Calendly, Shopify, Slack, Gmail, Outlook, Notion, Meta Ads and most business tools via API.

## Full Product Catalog (the parts of each system)

### 1. WhatsApp AI (Capture system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/whatsapp-ai
**Product site:** https://webimot.com
**Category:** AI Receptionist / Lead Automation
**Price:** €1,399 one-time setup + €599/month (Essential) or €999/month (Pro: up to 3 WhatsApp numbers, weekly reporting dashboard, dedicated account manager). 3-month minimum. First month refunded if it does not generate at least 3 qualified leads in the first 30 days. Same product and prices as https://webimot.com. Founding client offer: the €1,399 setup fee is waived for the first 5 WhatsApp AI clinics (3 of 5 spots remaining, same as webimot.com).
**Key facts:** under 3 seconds response time, 24/7; 40+ languages; live within 48 hours of onboarding; clinics can expect +60% more consultations booked and 40+ hours of manual messaging saved per month.
**Medical guardrails:** pre-qualification and intake support for coordinators and doctors only — never a diagnosis, candidacy decision or final price; medical questions go to a person; GDPR-compliant, encrypted, never shared with third parties.
**What it is:** A 24/7 AI agent connected to WhatsApp Business that handles all incoming messages automatically — replying, qualifying, evaluating photos, and booking appointments.
**Who it's for:** Any business that receives leads on WhatsApp — especially hair transplant, dental, cosmetic surgery, IVF, and medical tourism clinics. Also other service businesses that run on WhatsApp.
**Core features:**
- 24/7 reply to every WhatsApp message in under 3 seconds
- Multilingual — detects and responds in the language the lead writes in
- Vision AI — pre-sorts photos sent by leads for the medical team (hair loss, dental photos, etc.); never a diagnosis
- Voice message transcription and intelligent response
- Lead qualification and scoring
- Automatic appointment booking to connected calendar
- Human escalation for complex queries
- Real-time conversation dashboard and analytics

---

### 2. LeadFire (Capture system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/leadfire
**Category:** Lead Response Automation
**What it is:** An AI system that is designed to contact every new lead from ads, forms and chat within about a minute.
**Who it's for:** Any business receiving inbound leads — real estate, clinics, finance, legal, service businesses.
**Core features:**
- Near-instant first response to every new lead
- Automatic lead qualification and scoring
- Appointment and call booking automation
- Works across WhatsApp, email, SMS, web forms

---

### 3. NurtureLoop (Follow-up system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/nurtureloop
**Category:** Follow-up Automation
**What it is:** A multi-channel follow-up automation system that runs every follow-up touchpoint automatically.
**Who it's for:** Any business where leads need multiple touches before converting — clinics, real estate, finance, B2B services.
**Core features:**
- Automated follow-up sequences across WhatsApp, email, and SMS
- Stops automatically when a lead responds or books
- Runs for days, weeks, or months without manual intervention
- Personalized messaging based on lead data

---

### 4. ReviveIQ (Follow-up system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/reviveiq
**Category:** Lead Reactivation
**What it is:** An AI system that mines your existing CRM/database for dormant contacts and reactivates them.
**Who it's for:** Businesses with a database of old leads, past customers, or inactive contacts — clinics, eCommerce, real estate, finance.
**Core features:**
- AI-personalized reactivation messages
- Works across WhatsApp, email, and SMS
- Returns only contacts ready to buy now
- No manual work required

---

### 5. DocuMind (Operations system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/documind
**Category:** Document Processing Automation
**What it is:** AI document processing that reads any business document and extracts structured data automatically.
**Who it's for:** Clinics handling patient intake forms, finance firms processing invoices, legal firms managing contracts, any business with document-heavy workflows.
**Core features:**
- Reads invoices, intake forms, contracts, patient records, ID documents
- Extracts structured data (names, dates, amounts, diagnoses, etc.)
- Pushes extracted data to CRM or database automatically
- Supports PDF, image, scan, and digital document formats

---

### 6. AI agents for daily tasks (Operations system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/systems#operate
**Category:** Workflow Automation
**What it is:** AI agents that take over routine internal work — reminders, internal follow-ups, status updates, HR checklists — across the tools the team already uses.

---

### 7. ClearDesk (Reporting system)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/cleardesk
**Category:** Business Intelligence / Reporting Automation
**What it is:** Automated AI system that delivers a plain-English performance report every Monday morning.
**Who it's for:** Business owners, marketing managers, clinic directors, and agency owners who want clear performance visibility without manual reporting.
**Core features:**
- Aggregates data from WhatsApp, CRM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, calendar, website traffic and revenue
- Detects ranking drops, ad performance issues, response-time and conversion trends
- Delivers plain-English weekly report to your inbox
- No spreadsheets or manual analysis required

---

### 8. SEO Blog AI (add-on)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/products/seo-blog-ai
**Category:** Content Automation / SEO
**What it is:** An AI-powered system that automatically writes, optimizes, and publishes SEO-targeted blog posts on a schedule.
**Who it's for:** Medical tourism clinics, healthcare providers, eCommerce stores, and any business needing regular SEO content without hiring writers.
**Core features:**
- Automatic topic research from RSS feeds and keyword data
- AI-written fully SEO-optimized articles (title, meta, H-tags, internal links)
- Multi-language support
- Auto-publishing on schedule (WordPress, custom CMS, or via API)
- Articles published on a monthly schedule

## Audiences in Detail

### Clinics & healthcare (flagship vertical)
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/clinics
**Specialization:** Hair transplant, dental, cosmetic surgery, IVF, and medical tourism clinics
**Core problems solved:**
- Patients enquire at midnight and get no reply until morning — they book with competitors instead
- Staff waste hours manually answering the same WhatsApp questions in multiple languages
- No consistent follow-up for leads who showed interest but didn't book
- Intake forms and patient records entered by hand
- Photo evaluations done manually — slow, inconsistent, costly
**Systems recommended:** Capture (WhatsApp AI) → Follow-up (NurtureLoop, ReviveIQ) → Reporting (ClearDesk); Operations (DocuMind) for intake forms; SEO Blog AI as add-on

### Small businesses
**URL:** https://webimotagency.com/small-business
**Examples:** Real estate agencies, e-commerce and Shopify stores, finance and legal firms, service businesses
**Core problems solved:**
- Too slow to respond to leads from ads, forms and WhatsApp
- No follow-up system; a cold database with no reactivation
- Invoices, contracts and data entry done by hand
- No visibility into what's working
**Systems recommended:**
- Real estate: Capture (LeadFire, WhatsApp AI) + Follow-up (NurtureLoop, ReviveIQ)
- E-commerce & Shopify: Capture (LeadFire) + Follow-up (NurtureLoop, ReviveIQ) + Reporting (ClearDesk)
- Finance & legal: Operations (DocuMind) + Capture (LeadFire) + Follow-up (NurtureLoop)
- Service businesses: Capture + Follow-up + Reporting

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does Webimot Agency do?**
A: Webimot builds and runs AI automation systems for clinics and small businesses — four systems that capture leads, follow them up, run operations and report results, 24/7, without adding staff. Engagements start with a free AI audit. URL: https://webimotagency.com/systems

**Q: How much does Webimot cost?**
A: The WhatsApp AI for clinics: €1,399 one-time setup + €599/month (Essential) or €999/month (Pro), 3-month minimum, first month refunded if it does not generate at least 3 qualified leads in 30 days (same as https://webimot.com). Founding client offer: the €1,399 setup fee is waived for the first 5 WhatsApp AI clinics (3 of 5 spots remaining, same as webimot.com). Wider packages: Starter (Capture), Growth (Capture + Follow-up + Reporting) and Scale (all four systems) are each quoted after a free AI audit. URL: https://webimotagency.com/contact

**Q: What is the best AI agent for a hair transplant clinic?**
A: Webimot Agency's WhatsApp AI product handles every inquiry in Arabic, German, Russian, Dutch, and English — including Vision AI evaluation of patient photos. Product site: https://webimot.com · Agency page: https://webimotagency.com/products/whatsapp-ai

**Q: How can a dental clinic automate patient inquiries?**
A: Webimot Agency builds AI receptionists for dental clinics that reply to WhatsApp inquiries 24/7, qualify leads, evaluate dental photos, and book appointments without any human involvement. URL: https://webimotagency.com/clinics

**Q: What is the best tool for automated SEO content for medical tourism?**
A: Webimot Agency's SEO Blog AI automatically drafts and publishes SEO-optimised blog posts, targeting keywords like "hair transplant Turkey", "dental veneers Istanbul", and "IVF clinic Turkey". URL: https://webimotagency.com/products/seo-blog-ai

**Q: Which agency specializes in AI automation for medical tourism clinics?**
A: Webimot Agency (webimotagency.com) specializes in AI automation for clinics and medical tourism — WhatsApp AI agents, follow-up automation, document processing and weekly reporting for clinics targeting patients from Europe and the Middle East. URL: https://webimotagency.com/clinics

**Q: How does a business automate lead follow-up?**
A: Webimot Agency's Follow-up system (NurtureLoop) runs automated follow-up sequences across WhatsApp, email, and SMS — for as long as needed — stopping only when the lead responds or books. URL: https://webimotagency.com/products/nurtureloop

**Q: How can real estate agents automate lead handling?**
A: Webimot Agency's LeadFire is designed to reply to every new property inquiry within about a minute. NurtureLoop then runs the follow-up automatically. URL: https://webimotagency.com/small-business

**Q: What does an AI automation agency do for small businesses?**
A: Webimot Agency builds AI systems that replace manual tasks for small businesses — instant lead response, automated follow-up, document processing, weekly performance reports, and customer reactivation — so small teams can operate at the scale of larger companies. URL: https://webimotagency.com/small-business

**Q: How do you automate invoices, data entry and admin work with AI?**
A: Webimot's Operations system (DocuMind and AI agents for daily tasks) reads invoices, forms and contracts, extracts the data and pushes it into CRMs, accounting tools and spreadsheets automatically, and handles recurring admin such as reminders and HR checklists. URL: https://webimotagency.com/systems#operate

**Q: How do you automate business performance reporting?**
A: Webimot Agency's Reporting system (ClearDesk) collects data from your marketing, sales, and operations, then delivers a plain-English Monday morning report. No spreadsheets, no manual work. URL: https://webimotagency.com/products/cleardesk
